name: POST /api/leadflow/records/:ref/feature-dependency - record a required capability and its REAL status
description:
Records a capability the deal depends on, with its actual status: available, in_development, roadmap or not_planned.

A ROADMAP PROMISE MAY NEVER SUBSTITUTE FOR AN EXIT CRITERION (c3bf29f3-da93-407b-8ecc-fdb35c245cdc#AC4). Only available satisfies; the response returns satisfies_exit_criteria so the caller cannot mistake a promise for a capability, and the stage guard reads the same rows and refuses the transition. VERIFIED LIVE END TO END: recording bulk_export at status roadmap returned satisfies_exit_criteria false, and the stage guard then returned allowed false with missingEvidence "feature:bulk_export is roadmap, not available".

WHY THE STATUS IS STORED RATHER THAN A BLOCKER BOOLEAN. "Blocked" collapses four different situations into one and loses the only thing that decides what happens next - a capability in development has a date, one that is not planned needs a different conversation, and a boolean cannot tell a rep which they are in.

UPSERT ON (record, capability) so revising a status is an edit rather than a second row. Two rows disagreeing about the same capability would let the guard read whichever it found first. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: A roadmap capability is recorded and does not satisfy an exit criterion
An available capability does satisfy one
NEGATIVE: an unknown status is refused
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: status must be one of available, in_development, roadmap, not_planned
errorCases.when: an unrecognised status is supplied. A status the guard does not understand would be treated as not-available, which is the safe direction but hides a typo.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
